notes.title: New Year Update.
notes.content:
Happy New Year Solstice and Retro fans.

We know we're slow on Solstice updates, but here we are with a small update. We've improved the front-end adding a new options menu on the front screen, and tidying up some menus and added a little more conformity.

We've got plans for a new scenario soon, and some new terrain pieces, so watch this space in the next month or so.

In the meantime, enjoy the update, and fight the good fight!.

The JimJams Games team.
